verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੂਛੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise roop ra(n)g bidh poochhai a(n)dh a(n)dh prat aap hee na dhekhai taeh kaise kai dhikhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a blind person asks another blind person about the features and beauty of a person, how can he tell him, when he cannot see anything?

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪੂਛੇ ਬਹਰੋ ਜਉ ਬਹਰਾ ਪੈ ਸਮਝੈ ਨ ਆਪਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਮਝਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raag naadh baadh poochhe baharo jau baharaa pai samajhai na aap taeh kaise samajhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a deaf wishes to know about the tune and rhythm of a song from another person who is also deaf, then what can one who himself is deaf explain to the other deaf?

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁੰਗ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਹਿ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪੂਛੇ ਚਾਹੈ  ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise gu(n)g gu(n)g peh bachan bibek poochhe chaahai  bol na sakat kaise sabadh sunaaviee ||

en.bdb: If a dumb wants to learn something from another dumb, what can anyone who himself is unable to speak, explain to the other dumb?

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਖੋਜੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਆਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੭੪॥
verses.translit_en: bin satigur khojai braham giaan dhiaan anithaa agiaan mat aan pai na paaviee ||474||

en.bdb: Similarly it is foolishness to seek spiritual knowledge from other gods and goddesses leaving the True Guru who is perfect manifestation of the Lord. No one else can impart this wisdom or knowledge.  (474)
